description: Unique integer ID of the news item (1-5000). Rows 1-500 are the provided sample; 501-5000 are synthetic.
Anonymised publisher/outlet identifier. Used for EDA only, not as a model feature.
Number of words in the article body.
Overall sentiment polarity of the article text: -1 = very negative, 0 = neutral, +1 = very positive.
Number of exclamation marks in the article - a sensationalism indicator.
Fraction of words written entirely in CAPITAL letters (0.10 = 10 %) - a sensationalism indicator.
Ground-truth class: REAL = credible article, FAKE = misleading / fabricated article.
Political leaning of the outlet/article. Used ONLY for the fairness audit, never as a model input.
